{{Quote|You'll laugh, but for all the holocams in this city, we don't have anything watching down here. Which is where most of the crime is.|Anskow on policing Coruscant's lower levels|<ref name="Imperial Commando" />}}
'''Anskow''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], he served as a part time [[Galactic City/Legends|community]] [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. As the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] took primacy in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|policing]] Coruscant, the CSF was given fewer resources to patrol the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]], a fact which frustrated Anskow.<ref name="Imperial Commando" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Anskow and his squad pulled over an [[Unidentified lightsaber thief|individual]] who responded by attacking them with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The individual, who the police assumed to be a fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], fled and the squad chased him, eventually trapping him into a [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina (CSF chase)|cantina]] on Coruscant's lower levels. Anskow called in for support and [[Squad 40]], an [[Clone commando/Legends|Imperial Commando]] unit from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], was sent to assist. The commandos managed to enter the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the individual. Upon investigation, the individual turned out to be nothing more than a common [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] who came into possession of a lightsaber.<ref name="Imperial Commando" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anskow appeared in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Imperial Commando" />
